# Deesha Global Pte. Ltd.

> Guiding Growth Globally

Deesha Global Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based company working across People • Education • Technology. It operates as a Singapore Hub and an India–Asia Bridge, supporting families, students, professionals and institutions with guidance across education, careers and technology.

- Website: https://www.deesha-global.com/
- Contact: info@deesha-global.com
- Founder: Shashwati Guha, Founder & Director
- UEN: 202554716D

## Services

Deesha Global's work is organised around five pillars:

- **Co-Founder Launchpad** — From professional to co-founder in Singapore's startup ecosystem. Co-founder matching, validation, incorporation guidance, investor readiness. https://www.deesha-global.com/services/launchpad.html
- **Global Education Gateway** — School selection, admissions, transitions, and long-term pathways. Curriculum advisory, school selection, applications, transitions and settlement support. https://www.deesha-global.com/services/education.html
- **Career Compass** — Career clarity for students and professionals — clarity before speed. Assessments, 1:1 counselling, skills roadmap, job readiness. https://www.deesha-global.com/services/career.html
- **TutorHub** — Curated tutors, multi-curriculum support, progress tracking. Vetted tutors, multi-curriculum support, progress tracking. https://www.deesha-global.com/services/tutorhub.html
- **AI Mentor Lab** — 24/7 guidance powered by intelligence — human-led, tech-enabled. 24/7 guidance at scale — human-led, tech-enabled support. https://www.deesha-global.com/services/ai-mentor.html
